subject.title: LINE flex control cards and link buttons with overlong postback data or URLs are rejected with HTTP 400 and the whole reply is lost

question: For an oversized `video.externalLink` when a LINE imagemap already has the legal maximum of 50 actions, should OpenClaw preserve all valid actions and omit the invalid link without a visible fallback, or reserve/change reply composition to expose an unavailable-state warning?
rationale: Both choices can preserve API validity, but they differ in user-visible degradation and cannot be selected mechanically from LINE’s size limits alone.

options.title: Preserve valid actions
options.body: Keep all 50 valid imagemap actions and remove only the oversized external link when no warning action can be added.

options.title: Reserve fallback capacity
options.body: Change imagemap construction or reply composition so an unavailable-state fallback remains visible, at the cost of reducing or restructuring valid actions.

recommendation.title: Preserve valid actions
recommendation.body: Keep all 50 valid imagemap actions and remove only the oversized external link when no warning action can be added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged action-limit work is the closest established implementation precedent for channel-wide LINE action overflow behavior.
